JOYSTAR Little Rock Kids Bike - Sizes 12" to 16"
Fuel your child's passion for the outdoors with the JOYSTAR Little Rock Kids Bike. Expertly crafted as a sport-inspired children sports bicycle, this rugged toddler boy bike is engineered to bring style, performance, and unstoppable confidence to early riders aged 2 to 7 years old.

Built for little champions: The sporty JOYSTAR Little Rock featuring a race-ready front number plate and stable geometry.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Engineered with double braking safety features and all-terrain durability, the Little Rock provides a secure, action-packed riding experience."
Advanced Safety Systems
Safety is built into every frame element. The Little Rock comes standard with a reliable dual-braking setup, featuring a front hand caliper brake for learning premium stopping precision alongside a rear coaster brake for instant, intuitive foot-powered stops. Its durable, high-tensile steel frame provides absolute structural integrity, keeping your young adventurer safe through every bumpy sidewalk maneuver.

Rugged trail traction meets stable dual-braking controls for ultimate parent peace of mind.

Sport-Inspired Performance Ergonomics

Dual Brakes: Front handbrake paired with a rear coaster brake to maximize stopping options.

Enclosed Chain Guard: Fully integrated protective guard keeps pants and curious fingers clear of grease and drivetrain elements.

All-Terrain Stability: Extra-wide 2.125" pneumatic air tires deliver maximum tracking grip across concrete, gravel, or soil.

Grow-With-Me Alignment: Tool-free quick-release saddle and adjustable stem adapt quickly to your child's natural growth milestones.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Avoid assembly headaches and skip unnecessary hardware store trips. The JOYSTAR Little Rock arrives straight to your door **85% pre-assembled**. Simply follow our straightforward instruction packet to secure the handlebars, front wheel, adjustable saddle, and accessories in mere minutes.

Watch: Fast, straightforward assembly tips to get your children sports bicycle on the path today.

See It In Action
Watch how effortless outdoor adventures become when your little rider has the correct balance engineering right beneath them.

Watch the Little Rock in Action: High-performance, athletic build, and pure outdoor fun.

Included Accessories: Removable training wheels, front racing number plate, safety bike flag, handlebars bell, and essential assembly toolkits

Our Guarantee
Invest safely in your child's growth and development. Every JOYSTAR chassis frame is backed by our strict, manufacturer-direct Limited Lifetime Warranty.
